status: Source-qualified reconstruction estimates, promoted for cooked review only. No native night or whole-route visual acceptance.

developer.facts: 43 storeys, 308 units, 9,559 m² project/site area and car lifts to level 28. Site area is not a tower plate; level 28 does not establish the shorter return height.

cvu.facts: 144 m / 42 floors is a CVU estimate, not an as-built height survey; it differs from the developer storey count. Height uncertainty is approximately ±12 m. Sail is a separate 264.7 m tower.

operator.role: Public property directions point, not a surveyed footprint centroid.

photos.epoch: Capture year and camera bearing unverified.
Capture year and camera bearing unverified.

imagery.role: Four unmodified Esri World Imagery z19 tiles. Image epoch and geolocation accuracy unverified; retrieval date is not capture date. Ground/fence controls exclude displaced roof silhouettes.

streets.role: Literal source nodes for all mapped nearby highway arms. Untagged widths are explicit estimates used for clearance, not changes to any road.

registration.manual_control_uncertainty_m: Approximately 1–2 m, plus unverified source geolocation accuracy.
registration.method: Production derives the native frame using scene.geo and the expected route scale. No native origin or packed ground cache is read from this source record.

form.basis: Four lower WSW fingers, dominant ENE high wing, five narrow rounded corner loggia stacks, a shorter broad rounded return, and a pale round core continuing above it.
form.limits: Widths, depths, floor pitches, heights, corner bearing and narrow high-stack top extent are bounded photo/imagery reconstructions. Lower fingers are estimated 78–85 m / 23–25 levels; short return 90.5 m / 27 levels. Rear connector/courtyard boundaries remain unqualified and unmodeled. No fabricated Masarat OSM building ID.

ground_support.source: Actual already emitted native-format Runoff triangles after the existing venue and terrain stages.
ground_support.limits: Raised site, sloping frontage and DSM uncertainty remain possible. The photo supports an entrance ramp. Difference from the distant racing road does not prove roof contamination. Low-side basement closure reaches approximately 3.97 m and rear ground rises approximately 1.47 m above a first-floor estimate; these are not surveyed basement profiles.
ground_support.method: Clip only occupied interiors from each actual original triangle. Keep complete outside rows byte-for-byte and interpolate clipped positions/normals/UVs on that original face. Split foundation boundaries at every actual ground-plane crossing. No full-site pad, provider/field/road/contact mutation, global cutout union or radius change.

appearance.basis: Warm front and pale side/core are source-consistent; compass assignment remains tentative without camera bearings/epochs. Deep loggias, curved slabs, rails, stone pilasters, small windows and broad vertical glazing bands are original geometry.
appearance.night_limit: Daytime photos support the facade form; sparse occupied WarmGlass rooms are a restrained night estimate. No continuous emissive facade or renderer-wide exposure/energy change.
appearance.fence: Observed permanent black pickets on a white plinth along the registered south frontage, with estimated gate position. Temporary white construction hoarding is not treated as permanent.

residency.scope: Conservative normal-start sweep of 8,192 source centerline poses. Existing tile plus component bounds remain within the 2,050 m unload radius after initial load; maximum approximately 2,010.50 m. This is not actual moving-recorder evidence, and spawning directly at a distant pose differs from normal lap start.
residency.changes: No global radius or existing Diamond/Sail exception changes.

review.preview_role: Original flat technical geometry renders, not primary photographs or a native night pass.
review.next_gate: Fresh imported/cooked night views and matched whole-route review.

asset_use: Primary photographs, map nodes and aerial tiles are authoring evidence only. No reference pixels or source meshes are runtime game assets.

numeric_shared_edge_repair.scope: Third/fourth shared-edge triangulation and corrected wall/foundation winding. Source dimensions, placement, heights, materials and corner stacks are unchanged. No global buffer/make_valid operation or weakened invalid-footprint guard.
